body:
Fixes #374, the last of the three CMA-retirement PRs. Stacked on #373 (which stacks on #371); retargets to dev as they merge. Net: -687 lines from the production solver.

## Basis

Measured before removal, with both `SolveCore.optimize` and `CmaesJumpHarness.solve` disabled (the second kill covers the warm harness climbs the earlier audits missed): base sweep 52/52, shifted sweep 52/52, ProblemsTest 108/111 with the only failures being the three known dispositions below. The machinery carried nothing else.

## Changes

- Deleted from production: `CmaesRaceNode` plus its catalog registration and the raceWarm/raceColdFull/raceColdThrottled stages; the near-miss race and the CMA improve loop in `FreeStartImproveNode`; the `cmaBudget` plumbing (`budgetFor`, `Job`/`BlockJob` fields, `GraphContext.cmaBudget`); all cma*/closerEntry*/closerRepair*/climb* node params.
- Deterministic replacements where CMA was an inner step: `BlockSolver`'s slow planner pass now runs warm-seeded SLP; `HomotopyCloser`'s entry is best-effort SLP and its repair is the existing coordinate descent; `IlsPolish`'s climb keeps only its bucket polish.
- `SolveCore` and `CmaesJumpHarness` moved verbatim into the test tree (same package): the nix research probes keep their reference optimizer for the future multi-jump seam work; the shipped jars carry none of it, and the commons-math3 dependency stays (SlpSolve's simplex).
- THOROUGH rebalance: a from-scratch FIRST_FEASIBLE pattern B&B (`coldBnb`) on the no-candidate path, and momentum assembly capped at two fifths of the optimize budget (its closer entries are now live SLP work instead of a dead branch, so it could otherwise consume the whole budget).
- Tests: `AnytimeRaceTest`/`StopOnFeasibleTest` deleted (they tested SolveCore's race semantics); graph, preset and budget tests updated; AGENTS.md slow-list updated.

## Capture dispositions (per ruling)

- loopmm-tight-t39: **now solves CMA-free at THOROUGH** in 42 s via `receding horizon -> pattern B&B (cold) -> ILS`.
- gh313-j121-dfneo: shouldSolve false; the dF inequality class was retired in #372.
- nix-full-t1: shouldSolve false, run bounded to THOROUGH/45 s; accepted until the multi-jump seam work lands. TESTS.md documents both.

## Results

- `:core:check` and full `:core:test -PslowTests` green; gh283-j925-farseed 13.1 s and gh283-j990-cold 0.37 s keep their budgets on the pure deterministic stack.
- Base and shifted hpk sweeps both 52/52 on the removal build.

## Behavior notes for QA

- Saved custom graph presets containing the race node fail to load with the existing "Unknown node type" message; the preset is rebuilt without it.
- The solve-details panel no longer lists CMA-ES restarts/evals.
- On genuinely unsolvable momentum-heavy jumps, FAST can spend longer in momentum assembly before giving up than the race-era flow did (its closer entries now do real work); Solve remains cancelable.
title: feat(solver): remove the CMA-ES machinery from the production solver
